column1: # expectation is HAND-WRITTEN from docs/spec/tuning.md §2.51's row order and
# §5.3's stamp grammar, never captured from a run: the row each subject's
# part-table walk must stop at (read from `--emit-facts`' `part-layout`
# section), the artifact's `<PREFIX>_PART_LAYOUT` value and its `_WHY`.
#   precedence: an explicit value beats the preset's; a class value (P4-P6)
#   beats the threshold (P7); the threshold beats the residual (P8-P10); a
#   constraint row (P1-P3) beats every control; `measured` declines only
#   compound-inline: a class value reaches a compound's parts. Since
#   [FINDALL-NEXT] I1 a part's label table is in its own noinline
#   and the shell's always_inline `__find` gives each part `_next` as a
#   caller too: split no longer stops at P2/P3 (the row was `held-compound`
#   before I1). No CLI input reaches a compound constraint row now (a single-
#   caller part needs a driver entry request without `_next`); `/held` is
#   witnessed by the `constraint-*` rows, the same stamp code for every class.
# Columns: id, flags (or -), pattern, controls (space-separated), rows
# (FUNCTION=ROW, comma list; ROW `T0` where no control asked), stamp (or -),
